post.title: Why glasses, not eye exams, pay the eye care bills
post.ig:
Eye exams aren't the real money. Glasses are, 5 to 1.
National Vision (America's Best) took in $254.7M from eye exams in fiscal 2025, versus $1.27B from eyeglasses and sunglasses.
Exams were just 12.8% of its $1.99B revenue.
As of Dec 2024, 1,478 of its 2,393 optometrists (61.8%) worked for separate professional corporations.
Under the FTC Eyeglass Rule, eye doctors must give patients a free copy of their prescription right after the exam.
Sources: National Vision FY2025 and FY2024 Form 10-K, EssilorLuxottica FY2025 results, FTC.
